title: WaterWatchAI_WaterloggingImageAnnotationRecord
description: Standardized schema for image-level visual waterlogging annotations (bounding boxes, classifications, segmentation masks).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 capture timestamp if extracted from EXIF or metadata, else null

latitude.description: Capture latitude if GPS EXIF tag is present, else null

longitude.description: Capture longitude if GPS EXIF tag is present, else null

waterlogging_visible.description: 1 = Waterlogging visible in image, 0 = Dry scene / negative visual control

annotated_objects_count.description: Number of bounding boxes or segmented instances

apparent_severity_qualitative.description: Qualitative visual appearance. NOT an objective measurement of depth in cm.

depth_measurable.description: True ONLY if a calibrated physical water depth gauge/staff is visible in frame.
